claims.title: Normalized ES quartic and intrinsic-prime hypersurface
claims.statement: The normalized quartic with roots p,x,y,z has fixed U^3V coefficient one, recovers p=-5u4/u3, and lies on 625u0u4^3-125u3u4^2+25u2u3^2u4-4u3^4=0; the algebraic converse holds on D(u0u3u4).

claims.title: Complete eight-point signed fibre
claims.statement: A distinct-root arithmetic quartic lies in the finite etale degree-eight locus and has exactly the eight displayed signed source points.

claims.title: Prime-marked resultant-one pair
claims.statement: The two signed lifts marking p satisfy LC=H_ES, Res(L,C)=1, ad+bc=1 and 4af-be=0; the other six fibre states mark x,y,z.

claims.title: Turn 7 exterior image avoids the nonproper locus
claims.statement: Every actual Turn 7 exterior state has four distinct roots p,x,y,z and hence maps to u0 Disc(H) != 0; the strict chamber recovers all exterior coordinates from the coefficient target.

claims.title: Seven-state reciprocal suspension
claims.statement: The reciprocal cubic has a separate normalized suspension with seven states and lies on the u0=0 component of the nonproper locus.

claims.title: Fixed weighted-conductor transport
claims.statement: The invertible fixed maps Phi_* and Psi_* transport the nonlinear map, all fibres, deck action and exceptional loci through the original conductor identity T_A,* Phi_*=Psi_*.

claims.title: Root-algebra isomorphism and cross-ratio obstruction
claims.statement: A chosen root bijection gives a zero-kernel evaluation/interpolation algebra isomorphism; realization by one projective map is obstructed exactly by cross-ratio mismatch.

nonclaims: No universal ES occupancy theorem is inferred.
The coefficient hypersurface does not by itself impose the arithmetic source conditions.
No ES root is identified with a Riemann-zeta zero.
The fixed receiving isomorphism is not identified with the conductor.
